subject.title: fix(secrets): keep startup alive when TTS SecretRefs are missing

question: Should built-in TTS API-key SecretRefs become the first configured credential class allowed to degrade during cold activating Gateway startup while reload and config writes remain strict?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but choosing fail-open behavior for a configured SecretRef changes a documented startup and security policy that repository guidance reserves for explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Sponsor narrow TTS degradation
options.body: Accept the current no-config cold-start exception because optional speech credentials should not take unrelated Gateway capabilities offline.

options.title: Keep universal fail-fast
options.body: Reject the exception and require operators to repair or remove every configured unresolved SecretRef before Gateway startup.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Ask for a separate strictness setting, accepting additional configuration and upgrade surface instead of changing the default contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow TTS degradation
recommendation.body: Accept the current no-config cold-start exception because optional speech credentials should not take unrelated Gateway capabilities offline.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history-backed routing candidate for the documented Gateway secrets startup contract.
